svg.text: RGB + optional exterior 3D geometry condition the interpretation of directional response sequences.
SIDE / optical head, lane and sensing stations / 1:6
Host encoder reference X-1050. Station observations are sequential. Last required usable observation is TBD; downstream timing starts there. Slip, overlap, rolling and pose changes need

resolution, exposure, optical protection, calibration and dust management remain to be
The optional 3D device measures exterior shape/pose. No optical device is shown
measuring buried copper, and no electromagnetic response is treated as a validated
Pose/geometry-conditioned directional and frequency responses may help distinguish
conductive structures in layered fragments. Compare against strong simpler baselines;
